prompt: Create a factual map of South America showing national borders and labeling every country. Also label the Andes Mountains, Amazon River, Amazon Basin, Atacama Desert, Brazilian Highlands, Pacific Ocean, and Atlantic Ocean. Include a scale bar, north arrow, and legend.

spec.title: South America – National Borders and Physical Features (2026‑08‑13)
spec.subtitle: All sovereign states labeled with ISO‑3166‑1 numeric codes; major physical features shown.
spec.place: South America (including immediate offshore Pacific and Atlantic, and Panama for geographic continuity)

sources.title: NASA JPL: South America Physical Features
National Geographic: South America Physical Geography

notes: Borders are shown as de‑facto control per United Nations and World Bank data; they do not imply any political stance.
* Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas) – British Overseas Territory, claimed by Argentina.
** French Guiana – Overseas region of France.
spec.referenceSummary: Country names and ISO‑3166‑1 numeric codes are taken from the ISO catalogue (source 1) and cross‑checked with UN‑derived World Bank boundary data (source 3). Physical features (Andes, Amazon River, Amazon Basin, Atacama Desert, Brazilian Highlands) follow the descriptions and extents given by NASA J

checks.message: 14 mapped countries use Natural Earth 1:50m boundaries.
Every mapped region cites a declared web source.
10 web citations grounded the map specification.
Boundaries are schematic. Editorial review against the cited sources is required before publication.
French Guiana** is classified in the data but not drawn separately by the Natural Earth 1:50m boundary dataset.
